text: You see before you a Nightkin.
source_text: You see before you a Nightkin.

text: Die!
source_text: Die!

text: Leave me or die!
source_text: Leave me or die!

text: I don't like your tone. If my message does not get to the Master, I will see to it that your death is slow and painful.
source_text:
I don't like your tone. If my message does not get to the Master,
 I will see to it that your death is slow and painful.

text: I just wanted to compliment you on the great looking hump on your back. Your breath could use some work, though . . .
source_text:
I just wanted to compliment you on the great looking hump on your back.
 Your breath could use some work, though . . .

text: Could you direct me to the man in charge?
source_text: Could you direct me to the man in charge?

text: Man, you could use a drink worse than me!
source_text: Man, you could use a drink worse than me!

text: I'm not leaving!
source_text: I'm not leaving!

text: Okay. Me leave.
source_text: Okay. Me leave.

text: It is unwise to play games with the Nightkin. Get out of here!
source_text: It is unwise to play games with the Nightkin. Get out of here!

text: I do not think so.
source_text: I do not think so.

text: I shall enjoy watching you die!
source_text: I shall enjoy watching you die!

text: Do you not listen? It is unwise to ignore the Nightkin.
source_text: Do you not listen? It is unwise to ignore the Nightkin.

text: I must talk with you. It's urgent!
source_text: I must talk with you. It's urgent!

text: Nobody's ever accused me of being wise!
source_text: Nobody's ever accused me of being wise!

text: I just want to speak with the man in charge!
source_text: I just want to speak with the man in charge!

text: You supposed to be tough or something?
source_text: You supposed to be tough or something?

text: I'm sorry! Have a good day.
source_text: I'm sorry! Have a good day.

text: You wanna see unwise? It's unwise to give me lip, asshole!
source_text: You wanna see unwise? It's unwise to give me lip, asshole!

text: Go upstairs. Others of my kind will judge the worth of your message.
source_text: Go upstairs. Others of my kind will judge the worth of your message.

text: This is your last warning!
source_text: This is your last warning!

text: Sure it is! Big deal . . .
source_text: Sure it is! Big deal . . .

text: I REALLY need to speak with the guy in charge!
source_text: I REALLY need to speak with the guy in charge!

text: Okay! Okay! I'm sorry! Have a good day.
source_text: Okay! Okay! I'm sorry! Have a good day.

text: You know what your mistake is? You give warnings. I don't. Die!
source_text: You know what your mistake is? You give warnings. I don't. Die!

text: [done]
source_text: [done]
